sloka: सदस्या मम यज्ञेषु भवन्तो नित्यमेव तत् ।भविष्यथ महावीर्या ममानुग्रहकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ७.३६.५८ ॥
transliteration: sadasyā mama yajñeṣu bhavanto nityameva tat ।bhaviṣyatha mahāvīryā mamānugrahakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 7.36.58 ॥

translations.english: You, who are of great prowess and desire my favor, shall always indeed be the members of the assembly in my sacrifices.
